setup: s.level = Math.max(3, s.level); fill(3); return true;
after: const c = s.coach; c.carry = 'fins'; return true;

gif.every: s.setMovement(0.15, -1); const t = i / 65; const c = { pos: [-14 + t * 3, 4.5, 9 - t * 7], at: [-2 + t * 1, 0, 0 - t * 2], fov: 22 }; w.camera.position.set(...c.pos); w.camera.lookAt(...c.at); w.camera.updateMatrixWorld(true); w.placeCamera = function () { this.camera.clearViewOffset(); this.camera.fov = 22; this.camera.aspect = 1170 / 260; this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); this.camera.position.set(...c.pos); this.camera.lookAt(...c.at); this.camera.updateMatrixWorld(true); };
